title: Rates And Oil Fall, S&P Set To Blast Through All-Time Highs, Here Are The TOP Trades
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Yields stuck at the ~5.3% pivot (2007 high); he is bearish on yields and expects a pullback toward 5% as the economy weakens.
Dismisses Bessent's promise of fiscal discipline; forced austerity only comes if yields reach 7-10%.
Administration will talk oil down into the midterms; oil breaking double support.
Most bullish group: beaten down, cheap forward P/E, strong technical setups.
